title: The submission format, version 1
description: What a run submits for a work item: its branch, the commits in each repository, the verdict, and the draft pull request. The file of a version of the artifact type submission, which only qory's submit step writes.

ref.description: The branch's name, the same in each repository: qory/ followed by the work item's id.

verdict.description: The work item's newest verdict at the end of the run.

text.description: The title and the description of the draft pull request, from the session's hand-off file. Absent when the session wrote none.

title.description: One line of text with a character that shows, as $defs title defines it.

repositories.description: Each repository with the commit of the branch in it, at least one.

system.description: The host the repository is on, such as github.com: a lower-case host name of at most 253 characters.

path.description: The repository's path on the host, such as acme/web: at most 200 characters of segments joined by slashes, with no ., .. or .git segment.

commit.description: The head of the branch: a full commit id, 40 or 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

commit_url.description: The forge's address of the head. The submit program writes it.

base.description: The commit the run started at.

branch.description: The name of the repository's default branch when the run started: the branch that a pull request of the run is based on. A branch name that git accepts after refs/heads/, at most 255 characters. Absent when qory did not read it.

commits.description: Each commit from the base to the head, oldest first, with the ledger step that made it. The last one is the head.

draft.description: The draft pull request, or the reason there is none.

title.description: One line of text with a character that shows, as $defs title defines it.

commit.description: A full commit id: 40 or 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

line.description: One line of text: no control character (so no tab, line feed or carriage return), no U+2028 or U+2029, and no format character (Unicode category Cf) but U+200C and U+200D, the joiners of emoji. The pattern is the one of $defs line in primitives.schema.json.

text.description: Markdown that may span lines. Of the control characters it has only tab, line feed and carriage return, and it has no U+2028, U+2029 or format character (Unicode category Cf) but U+200C and U+200D, the joiners of emoji. The pattern is the one of $defs text in primitives.schema.json.

visible.description: A title has a character other than spaces and joiners (U+200C, U+200D). The pattern is the one in $defs title of primitives.schema.json.
